description: This file provides a transformation layer for Pydantic AI agents within a larger system, managing request formatting, polling for task completion, converting responses into standardized formats, and simulating streaming responses from non-streaming API calls.

classes.name: PydanticAITransformation
classes.description: A static class providing methods to handle interactions with Pydantic AI agents, including request formatting, polling, response transformation, and fake streaming.

methods.name: Any _remove_none_values(obj: Any)
methods.description: Recursively removes None values from nested dicts or lists to conform to API expectations.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _params_to_dict(params: Any)
methods.description: Converts input parameters, possibly Pydantic models, into dictionaries suitable for API requests.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _poll_for_completion( client: AsyncHTTPHandler, endpoint: str, task_id: str, request_id: str, max_attempts: int = 30, poll_interval: float = 0.5, )
methods.description: Polls repeatedly for task completion status until task is completed, failed, or canceled, or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _send_and_poll_raw( api_base: str, request_id: str, params: Any, timeout: float = 60.0, )
methods.description: Sends a request to initiate a Pydantic AI task and polls for its completion, returning the raw task response.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] send_non_streaming_request( api_base: str, request_id: str, params: Any, timeout: float = 60.0, )
methods.description: Public interface to send a request and wait for a non-streaming response, returning formatted output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] send_and_get_raw_response( api_base: str, request_id: str, params: Any, timeout: float = 60.0, )
methods.description: Public method to send a request and directly retrieve the raw task response, used for fake streaming.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _transform_to_a2a_response( response_data: Dict[str, Any], request_id: str, )
methods.description: Converts Pydantic AI task response containing artifacts and history into a standard A2A non-streaming message format.

methods.name: tuple[str,str,list] _extract_response_text(response_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts the message text, message ID, and parts from a completed task response.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[Dict[str,Any]] fake_streaming_from_response( response_data: Dict[str, Any], request_id: str, chunk_size: int = 50, delay_ms: int = 10, )
methods.description: Converts a finished non-streaming response into a series of fake streaming chunks, emulating real-time updates with delays.
